item.title: Glycemic variability and heart failure hospitalizations in type 2 diabetes: a prospective cohort study
item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Higher visit-to-visit HbA1c variability predicted incident heart failure hospitalization in patients with type 2 diabetes.
